entityTypes.name: subject
entityTypes.description: One animal (C57BL/6N mouse (16-24 days old)). The data descriptor: 'The data are organized by subjects (animals). All the data recorded from the same subject are collected in one folder (named by cell type, subject number and date of recording).'

entityTypes.name: recording
entityTypes.description: One ABF file: one protocol applied to one stellate cell. The data descriptor: 'The protocol applied in each case is indicated in the filename. If more than one cell was recorded from different slices cut from the same subject, different prefixes (A/B) were used to indicate the different cells.'

subject_id.name: subject_id
subject_id.title: Subject number
subject_id.description: Two-digit subject number from the folder name <celltype>_Subject<NN>_<ddMMyy>.

recording_date.name: recording_date
recording_date.title: Recording date
recording_date.description: Date of recording from the subject folder name, written ddMMyy. The file names carry the date too, but drop leading zeros in some files, so the folder is read.

protocol.name: protocol
protocol.title: Protocol
protocol.description: Protocol named in the file name, lowercased: IV, gap free, CC step, EPSP and EPSC (parallel fibre stimulation; the number of pulses and the frequency follow in the name, e.g. EPSC_20 pulses100Hz).

dataLocations.description: Locatelli et al., whole cell patch-clamp recordings of cerebellar stellate cells (dataset version 3ca4af33-64bd-437a-9c53-2dac19e10168). One folder per animal, <SC>_Subject<NN>_<ddMMyy>, holding one ABF file per recording; the data descriptor and the licence at the root. The data descriptor places its files in a folder bp00sp01/ that the bucket does not have. Every entry of the bucket was listed.
